detail.abstract: River water recharge wells represent a critical technology for sustainable water resource management. By directly injecting or infiltrating river or surface water into aquifers, nations have developed strategies to combat groundwater depletion, ensure drought resilience, and enhance long-term water security. This paper reviews international practices in Australia, the United States, Israel, and other regions, highlighting technical methods, performance metrics, and socioeconomic benefits. Findings show that river-sourced managed aquifer recharge (MAR) systems, when properly designed, monitored, and managed, can significantly stabilize groundwater levels, reduce evaporation losses, and enhance environmental resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了国际河流水源补给井（MAR）实践，分析了澳大利亚、美国、以色列等国的技术方法、性能指标和社会经济效益，证明合理设计的河流水源补给系统能有效稳定地下水位、减少蒸发损失并增强环境韧性。

AI.motivation: 地下水枯竭是全球性问题，需要可持续的水资源管理技术。河流水源补给井作为关键技术，能直接向含水层注入或渗透河水，对抗地下水枯竭、确保干旱韧性并增强长期水安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续水资源管理理论、地下水补给理论和生态系统服务理论，探讨河流水源补给井在技术、环境和社会经济层面的综合效益。

AI.findings: 研究发现，当河流水源补给井系统得到合理设计、监测和管理时，能显著稳定地下水位、减少蒸发损失并增强环境韧性，具有显著的社会经济效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了可持续水资源管理理论，为地下水补给技术提供了国际比较框架，拓展了生态系统服务理论在水资源管理中的应用。

title:
Quantitative Geometric Market Structuralism (QGMS)
A Framework for Detecting Structural Endpoints in Financial Market

detail.title:
Quantitative Geometric Market Structuralism (QGMS)
A Framework for Detecting Structural Endpoints in Financial Market
detail.abstract: This study introduces the Quantitative Geometric Market Structuralist (QGMS) framework — a hybrid analytical methodology integrating geometric pattern recognition with quantitative mathematical modeling to identify terminal zones of large-scale market movements. Unlike conventional econometric or signal-based models, the QGMS framework conceptualizes market dynamics as evolving geometric structures governed by self-organizing principles of price formation. To preserve the proprietary nature of its internal mathematical architecture, the methodology employs a blind-testing validation process, wherein price, symbol, and temporal identifiers are concealed during analysis. This design ensures objective verification without revealing the underlying algorithmic core. The framework’s predictive robustness has been empirically examined across multiple financial crises, including the 2008 Global Financial Collapse, the 2015 EUR/CHF SNB event, the 2016 Brexit referendum, and the 2020 COVID-19 market crash. In each case, the system consistently identified structural endpoints preceding major market reversals. The findings suggest that geometric–quantitative market interpretation may offer a new class of predictive tools bridging the gap between mathematical formalism and empirical price behavior. By combining academic testability with intellectual property protection, the QGMS framework establishes a viable foundation for institutional evaluation and further research into non-linear structural forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了QGMS框架，这是一种结合几何模式识别与定量数学建模的混合分析方法，用于识别大规模市场运动的终点区域。该方法将市场动态概念化为受价格形成自组织原则支配的演化几何结构，并通过盲测验证过程保护其专有数学架构。实证测试表明该框架在多次金融危机中能一致识别市场反转前的结构端点。
AI.research_question: 几何-定量市场解释能否提供一类新的预测工具，弥合数学形式主义与经验价格行为之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 传统计量经济学或基于信号的模型在预测大规模市场运动终点方面存在局限性，需要新的分析方法来理解市场动态的结构性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: QGMS框架基于市场动态作为演化几何结构的概念，受价格形成的自组织原则支配，将几何模式识别与定量数学建模相结合。
AI.method: 采用盲测验证过程，在分析过程中隐藏价格、符号和时间标识符，以客观验证框架的预测能力而不泄露底层算法核心。在多次金融危机事件中进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 在2008年全球金融危机、2015年EUR/CHF SNB事件、2016年英国脱欧公投和2020年COVID-19市场崩盘等事件中，系统一致地识别了主要市场反转前的结构端点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了几何-定量市场解释作为一类新的预测工具，弥合了数学形式主义与经验价格行为之间的理论差距，为非线性的结构预测模型提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立了结合学术可测试性与知识产权保护的框架，为机构评估和进一步研究非线性结构预测模型提供了可行基础，具有实际应用价值。

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Why does the banking industry remain prone to large and costly disruptions despite being so heavily regulated? Is there a need for more regulation, less regulation, or simply different regulation? Our recent Staff Report combines insights from academic research in economics, finance, and accounting to provide a deeper understanding of the challenges involved in designing and implementing bank regulation, as well as opportunities for future exploration. This post focuses on the regulation of bank capital, but the ideas are applicable more broadly.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2025/12/designing-bank-regulation-with-accounting-discretion/

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨银行业监管困境：尽管监管严格，银行业仍频繁出现大规模、高成本的危机。研究结合经济学、金融学和会计学视角，分析银行资本监管设计中的挑战，特别关注会计自由裁量权的影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么银行业在严格监管下仍易发生大规模、高成本的危机？需要更多监管、更少监管，还是不同类型的监管？
AI.motivation: 银行业频繁发生危机（如2008年金融危机）造成巨大社会成本，尽管已有严格监管体系。这引发对现有监管有效性的质疑，需要从多学科角度重新审视监管设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合经济学、金融学和会计学理论，特别关注信息不对称、代理问题、监管套利、会计自由裁量权等概念，分析监管设计的理论基础。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，整合多个学科的研究成果，构建分析框架。基于纽约联储工作人员报告，进行概念性分析而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 现有监管存在设计缺陷，特别是会计自由裁量权可能削弱监管效果。监管设计需要考虑银行的行为反应和会计实践的现实约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供跨学科的监管分析框架，强调会计自由裁量权在监管有效性中的关键作用，为监管设计理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供改进监管设计的建议，指出需要更精细地考虑会计实践和银行行为，而非简单地增加或减少监管。

title: Re-thinking Diversification: Harnessing the Diversification Potential of AI Stocks and Cryptocurrencies using Portfolio Optimization
affiliations: American University of the Middle East, Western Sydney University, Western Sydney University and American University of Middle East. Kuwait

detail.title: Re-thinking Diversification: Harnessing the Diversification Potential of AI Stocks and Cryptocurrencies using Portfolio Optimization
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) stocks and AI cryptocurrencies in portfolio diversification, reflecting on the rising interest in technology-oriented assets. While much research has focused on the diversification, hedging, and safe-haven properties of digital assets, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, this study focuses on whether AI cryptocurrencies and AI stocks provide untapped diversification potential. Using mean-variance, risk parity, and higher-order moments approaches, we construct portfolios that combine AI stocks, AI cryptocurrencies, and traditional assets under various optimization frameworks. The findings reveal that the mean-variance framework is more conservative in allocating to AI cryptocurrencies, while the higher-order moments approach accommodates for greater flexibility. Seemingly, investors may benefit from expanding their asset pool to incorporate AI stocks and AI cryptocurrencies. Across most portfolio settings, gold and commodities dominate allocations, followed by AI stocks, with AI cryptocurrencies receiving only marginal weights owing to their high volatility. However, allocations to AI cryptocurrencies increase as investor risk tolerance increases, thereby highlighting their potential for risk-seeking portfolios. Overall, the results indicate that AI stocks and AI cryptocurrencies can enhance portfolio diversification and improve risk-return outcomes. These results offer valuable insights for investors seeking to optimize their portfolios, through exposure to emerging technology-driven assets while balancing traditional risk considerations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI股票和AI加密货币在投资组合分散化中的作用，发现这些新兴科技资产能增强投资组合多样化并改善风险收益表现，但分配权重受投资者风险偏好和优化框架影响。
AI.research_question: AI股票和AI加密货币是否能为投资组合提供未被充分利用的分散化潜力？
AI.motivation: 随着对科技导向资产兴趣的上升，现有研究主要关注比特币和以太坊等数字资产的分散化、对冲和避险特性，但AI股票和AI加密货币的分散化潜力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合理论、资产配置理论、风险分散化理论、现代投资组合理论（均值-方差框架）、风险平价理论、高阶矩方法
AI.method: 使用均值-方差、风险平价和高阶矩方法，构建包含AI股票、AI加密货币和传统资产的投资组合，并在不同优化框架下进行分析。
AI.findings:
1. 均值-方差框架对AI加密货币的配置较为保守，而高阶矩方法允许更大的灵活性
2. 黄金和大宗商品在大多数投资组合中占据主导地位，其次是AI股票，AI加密货币因高波动性仅获得边际权重
3. 随着投资者风险容忍度的增加，对AI加密货币的配置权重相应增加
4. AI股票和AI加密货币能够增强投资组合分散化并改善风险收益结果
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了投资组合分散化理论，将新兴科技资产（AI股票和AI加密货币）纳入分析框架
2. 比较了不同优化框架（均值-方差、风险平价、高阶矩）在配置科技资产时的表现差异
3. 为投资者风险偏好与资产配置决策之间的关系提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了将AI股票和AI加密货币纳入投资组合的具体配置策略
2. 帮助投资者根据自身风险容忍度调整科技资产的配置比例
3. 为投资组合管理者提供了优化风险收益表现的实用框架
4. 指导投资者在平衡传统风险考量的同时，获得新兴科技驱动资产的敞口

title: Constitutive Legality in Alliance Implementation: Why USAF EDI MILCON Advanced in Poland but Stalled in Slovakia
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Constitutive Legality in Alliance Implementation: Why USAF EDI MILCON Advanced in Poland but Stalled in Slovakia
detail.abstract:
Objectives: This article explains why nominally similar European Deterrence Initiative (EDI) Military Construction (MILCON) programs progressed in Poland but stalled in Slovakia. Building on Resource Dependence Theory, it examines how Defense Cooperation Agreements (DCAs) operate as constitutive resources that condition the payoff to boundary-work tactics in multinational execution networks. 

Methods: A most-similar systems design compares the country-level execution network in each case (USAF/EUCOM/USAFE / U.S. Embassy ODC / host-nation ministries and base commands). Evidence triangulates unclassified documents (2017-2020) and ten non-attribution practitioner interviews (2021-2022). Analysis uses a deductive codebook (Johnson's five RDT foci plus buffering/bridging) followed by pattern coding; the outcome, execution effectiveness, is operationalized as milestone attainment/continuity and time-to-first-award. 

Results: Poland's mature DCA and implementing arrangements formalized direct liaison authority, stabilized roles (including information-sharing and environmental responsibilities), and amplified returns to buffering/bridging (bilingual deliverables, signed "key-points," LRDPs, predictable escalation). Slovakia lacked a suitable DCA; routine design actions were reframed as sovereignty incursions, politicization cascaded, ODC capacity was overstretched , and the program halted in March 2019. Poland reached first completion in spring 2019. ODC capacity and communication discipline moderated these effects but could not substitute for legal scaffolding. 

Conclusions: In multinational public programs, legal architecture is a first-order resource. Where a DCA exists, boundary-work tactics compound and execution proceeds; without it, even diligent coordination struggles under politicization. The study offers actionable guidance-sequence legality before speed, resource ODC nodes, and institutionalize bilingual communication-and notes the small-N, qualitative scope as a limitation with clear implications for allied posture initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本文基于资源依赖理论，解释为何相似的欧洲威慑倡议军事建设项目在波兰进展顺利而在斯洛伐克停滞。研究发现，国防合作协议作为构成性资源，通过影响边界工作策略的回报，决定了跨国执行网络的有效性。
AI.research_question: 为什么名义上相似的欧洲威慑倡议军事建设项目在波兰进展顺利而在斯洛伐克停滞？国防合作协议如何作为构成性资源影响跨国执行网络中的边界工作策略？
AI.motivation: 理解跨国公共项目中法律架构对项目执行的关键作用，为盟国军事合作项目提供实践指导，特别是在欧洲威慑倡议等战略安全项目中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源依赖理论（RDT），特别是Johnson的五个焦点（资源获取、权力依赖、不确定性管理、组织间关系、环境约束）以及缓冲/桥接策略。
AI.method: 采用最相似系统设计，比较波兰和斯洛伐克的国家级执行网络。证据三角测量包括未分类文件（2017-2020）和10次非署名从业者访谈（2021-2022）。使用演绎编码本（RDT五个焦点加缓冲/桥接）进行模式编码。
AI.findings: 波兰成熟的国防合作协议正式化了直接联络权限，稳定了角色（包括信息共享和环境责任），并放大了缓冲/桥接策略的回报。斯洛伐克缺乏合适的国防合作协议，常规设计行动被重新定义为主权侵犯，政治化蔓延，项目于2019年3月停止。波兰在2019年春季完成首个项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国防合作协议概念化为构成性资源，扩展了资源依赖理论在跨国公共项目中的应用。展示了法律架构如何作为一级资源条件化边界工作策略的回报，影响执行网络的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作指导：1）合法性优先于速度；2）为国防合作办公室节点提供资源；3）制度化双语沟通。对盟国军事合作项目有直接实践意义。

reference: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. RB3-2025
title: Deindustrialization, Polarization, and Extremism in the Rust Belt
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh and University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: Deindustrialization, Polarization, and Extremism in the Rust Belt

publicationDetails.detailsText: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. RB3-2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Governance & Markets Paper Series

detail.abstract: Right-wing extremism has emerged as one of the most extreme manifestations of political polarization, particularly in the context of long-term economic and social decline in the Rust Belt. Once the heart of American industrial power, Rust Belt communities have faced decades of deindustrialization, population loss, and institutional erosion-conditions that have produced not only economic despair but also fertile ground for political radicalization. Extremism is not a fringe phenomenon but rather a concept that is structurally linked to the broader processes of polarization and disaffection. These dynamics are especially acute in postindustrial communities with high concentrations of disaffected veterans, weakened civic institutions, and limited access to economic opportunity. These trends can be countered by a three-pronged strategy of socioeconomic revitalization, veteran support, and community policing-aimed at restoring resilience and undermining the appeal of extremist mobilization.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国铁锈地带右翼极端主义的兴起，认为这是政治极化的极端表现，与经济衰退、社会衰落密切相关。研究提出通过社会经济振兴、退伍军人支持和社区警务三管齐下的策略来应对极端主义。
AI.research_question: 铁锈地带长期经济和社会衰退如何催生右翼极端主义，以及如何通过综合策略有效应对这种极端主义？
AI.motivation: 右翼极端主义已成为美国政治极化最极端的表现之一，特别是在铁锈地带经历了数十年去工业化、人口流失和制度侵蚀的背景下。这些社区面临经济绝望，为政治激进化提供了肥沃土壤，需要深入理解极端主义与更广泛极化过程的结构性联系。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 政治极化理论：极端主义作为政治极化的极端表现
2. 结构-机会理论：经济衰退和社会制度侵蚀为极端主义创造机会结构
3. 社会解体理论：社区制度弱化导致社会控制减弱和激进思想传播
4. 资源动员理论：极端组织如何利用社区不满情绪进行动员
AI.method: 基于文献综述和理论分析的方法，结合铁锈地带社区案例研究，分析经济衰退、社会变迁与极端主义兴起之间的结构性关系。
AI.findings:
1. 铁锈地带的去工业化、人口流失和制度侵蚀创造了极端主义滋生的结构性条件
2. 退伍军人集中、公民机构薄弱和经济机会有限的社区特别容易受到极端主义影响
3. 极端主义不是边缘现象，而是与更广泛的政治极化过程有结构性联系
4. 后工业社区中的不满情绪为极端组织动员提供了社会基础
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将极端主义概念化为政治极化的结构性表现而非孤立现象
2. 建立了经济衰退、社会制度侵蚀与极端主义兴起之间的理论联系
3. 提出了后工业社区极端主义易感性的理论框架
4. 拓展了资源动员理论在极端主义研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出三管齐下的应对策略：社会经济振兴、退伍军人支持和社区警务
2. 为政策制定者提供基于社区的具体干预措施
3. 强调恢复社区韧性的重要性以削弱极端主义吸引力
4. 为类似后工业社区的极端主义预防提供可操作框架

title: Powering the Future: The Impact of China's Outward Investment on Africa's Energy Landscape
affiliations: University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China, University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China and

detail.title: Powering the Future: The Impact of China's Outward Investment on Africa's Energy Landscape
detail.abstract: This study examines the effect of China's outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) on energy sector development in Africa. China is currently the most important investment and trading partner of Africa, and with the passage of time the political relations between them are also deepening, taking shape to surpass that of the colonial master countries of Africa, and also the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) countries which for some time past were dominant. We examine both the direct and spillover effect of Chinese OFDI on electricity access for 48 African countries from 2003-2022 using the Spatial Durbin model. First, our findings reveal clear evidence spatial dependency in energy access across countries. Second, we find that Chinese OFDI stock has a direct positive effect on national electricity access but has no significant impact on rural and urban access to electricity as well as access inequality. The indirect effects reveal that the positive influence of Chinese OFDI in a focal country extends to its neighbors, enhancing their national and urban electricity access. The total effects underscore the importance of Chinese OFDI in improving national and urban electricity access, supporting the broader argument that FDI inflows contribute to expanding energy access in Africa. Finally, while OFDI flows show no significant effects on energy access, OFDI stock demonstrates stronger and more consistent direct and spillover impacts, solidifying its role as a long-term driver of regional energy infrastructure development. These results are robust across different specifications of spatial relationships and other methodological adjustments.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用空间杜宾模型分析2003-2022年中国对非洲OFDI对48个非洲国家电力可及性的影响，发现OFDI存量对全国电力可及性有直接正面影响，并通过空间溢出效应改善邻国电力供应，而OFDI流量影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 中国对外直接投资（OFDI）如何影响非洲能源部门发展？具体而言，中国OFDI对非洲国家电力可及性（全国、城乡）有何直接和间接（空间溢出）效应？
AI.motivation: 中国已成为非洲最重要的投资和贸易伙伴，双边政治关系不断深化，甚至超越非洲前殖民宗主国和OECD国家。然而，中国OFDI对非洲能源基础设施发展的具体影响机制尚不明确，特别是其空间溢出效应需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于FDI促进东道国发展的理论，结合空间经济学理论，考虑国家间的空间依赖性。重点关注OFDI存量与流量的差异效应，以及直接效应与间接（空间溢出）效应的区分。
AI.method: 使用空间杜宾模型（Spatial Durbin model）分析48个非洲国家2003-2022年的面板数据，检验中国OFDI对电力可及性的直接和间接效应。采用不同空间关系设定进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 非洲国家电力可及性存在显著空间依赖性；2. 中国OFDI存量对全国电力可及性有直接正面影响，但对城乡电力可及性及不平等无显著影响；3. 间接效应显示中国OFDI对焦点国家的积极影响会溢出到邻国，改善其全国和城市电力可及性；4. OFDI流量影响不显著，而OFDI存量作为长期驱动因素作用更稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将空间维度引入FDI对能源发展影响的研究，证实了跨国溢出效应的存在；2. 区分OFDI存量与流量的不同效应，强调长期投资积累的重要性；3. 为中国在非洲投资的经济地理效应提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲国家制定能源政策提供依据，建议重视吸引长期OFDI；2. 为中国"一带一路"倡议在非洲的能源投资提供实证支持；3. 提示政策制定者考虑投资的空间溢出效应，促进区域能源合作；4. 为国际发展机构评估中国在非洲投资影响提供参考。

title: Cryptocurrency and Financial Terrorism: An Emerging Paradox in India

detail.title: Cryptocurrency and Financial Terrorism: An Emerging Paradox in India
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of cryptocurrencies presents a significant challenge in global financial security architecture. In India, particularly the new era of financial innovation and cryptocurrency offers a sophisticated mean of money laundering and financial terrorism. Individuals and Companies uses cryptocurrencies as a medium of exchange. This paper argues that India's current legal system particularly the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 is inadequate to talk about the unique, decentralized and pseudonymous nature of cryptocurrency. The Cryptocurrency features make the law enforcement authorities difficult in tracing the transaction. When the new digital payment in cryptocurrency developed namely Bitcoin, the terrorist is the first one who take advantage of digitalization to increase profitability. In cryptocurrency the confidentiality is extremely fragile, decentralized and pseudo-anonymous characteristics makes it easier to do crime. This paper analyzed that a cryptocurrency is a prominent tool for money laundering and terrorist financing because of its anonymous features over owner's money. This paper evaluates the legal hurdles in prosecuting cross-border crypto transaction linked to terrorist financing. Finally, by suggesting that India must recognize the need for strong regulation to fight cryptocurrency facilitated financial terrorism.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为印度现行反洗钱法律体系难以应对加密货币的去中心化、匿名性特征，导致加密货币成为洗钱和恐怖融资的重要工具，建议印度需要建立强有力的监管框架来应对加密货币相关的金融恐怖主义。
AI.research_question: 印度现行法律体系（特别是《2002年防止洗钱法》）是否足以应对加密货币在洗钱和恐怖融资方面的独特挑战？
AI.motivation: 加密货币的快速增长对全球金融安全架构构成重大挑战，其去中心化、匿名性特征被用于洗钱和恐怖融资活动，而印度现行法律体系难以有效监管这些新型金融犯罪。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融安全理论、反洗钱法律框架、加密货币监管理论、恐怖融资机制分析
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、比较法分析、加密货币技术特征分析
AI.findings:
1. 加密货币的匿名性和去中心化特征使其成为洗钱和恐怖融资的理想工具
2. 印度《2002年防止洗钱法》难以追踪加密货币交易
3. 恐怖分子是首批利用加密货币数字化的群体之一
4. 跨境加密货币交易给执法带来法律障碍
5. 现行法律体系在应对加密货币相关犯罪方面存在不足
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了加密货币监管与反洗钱法律框架的适配性理论
2. 发展了数字时代金融恐怖主义的新分析框架
3. 为加密货币监管提供了法律与技术交叉的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 识别了印度现行法律在加密货币监管方面的具体缺陷
2. 提出了加强加密货币监管的政策建议
3. 为执法机构应对加密货币相关犯罪提供了实践指导
4. 为跨境加密货币交易的法律追诉提供了解决方案

title: Post-IPO Valuation and Cost of Capital: Analysis of Figma Inc. Applying Bottom-Up Approach to SaaS Startups Equity Research

detail.title: Post-IPO Valuation and Cost of Capital: Analysis of Figma Inc. Applying Bottom-Up Approach to SaaS Startups Equity Research
detail.abstract: This paper apply a basic bottom-up approach to value Figma Inc., one of the prominent SaaS providers in the collaborative design community, on the heels of their initial public offering. Due to the lack of Figma's post-listing markets data, the study will rely on betas calibrated across peers, the capital assets pricing model estimates of the cost of equity, sensitivity analysis, and other methods to provide a consistent, even if rough, estimate of the cost of capital. The resultant estimate of the weighted average cost of capital of about 8 percent is, in fact, consistent with the financial profile of technology firms that had raised growth capital via the equity markets shortly after their initial public offering. The study, apart from its application to Figma Inc., will also outline the benefits of having simple yet theoretically justifiable models of firm valuation, even in settings with weak or non-existent data on some of the conventional estimates of value.

AI.tldr: 本文采用自下而上的基本方法对协作设计社区中著名的SaaS提供商Figma Inc.进行估值，特别关注其首次公开募股后的情况。由于缺乏Figma上市后的市场数据，研究通过同行校准的贝塔系数、资本资产定价模型估算股权成本、敏感性分析等方法，提供了约8%的加权平均资本成本估计值，这与科技公司在IPO后通过股权市场筹集增长资本时的财务特征一致。
AI.research_question: 如何在缺乏上市后市场数据的情况下，为Figma Inc.这样的SaaS公司提供一致且合理的估值估计？
AI.motivation: Figma作为协作设计社区中重要的SaaS提供商，在IPO后缺乏足够的市场数据，需要开发适用于数据有限情况下的估值方法，为投资者和分析师提供参考框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自下而上的估值方法、资本资产定价模型（CAPM）、加权平均资本成本（WACC）理论、敏感性分析框架
AI.method: 使用同行校准的贝塔系数、资本资产定价模型估算股权成本、敏感性分析和其他方法，在缺乏Figma上市后市场数据的情况下提供一致的资本成本估计
AI.findings: 估算出的加权平均资本成本约为8%，这与科技公司在IPO后通过股权市场筹集增长资本时的财务特征一致，验证了该方法在数据有限情况下的适用性
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了即使在缺乏传统估值所需数据的情况下，简单但理论上合理的估值模型仍然可以提供有意义的估计，扩展了估值理论在数据有限环境中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为Figma Inc.提供了具体的估值参考（约8%的WACC），为投资者和分析师在数据有限情况下评估类似科技公司提供了实用框架和方法论指导

title: Heterogeneous Effects of Inflation Shocks in Nicaraguan Households

detail.title: Heterogeneous Effects of Inflation Shocks in Nicaraguan Households

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no particular interest with an organization when writing the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not have ethical issues.
declarations.funderStatement: Nobody funded the research process.

detail.abstract: Inflation is often considered a “regressive tax” that can disproportionately affect the most vulnerable individuals. This issue has become central in a context of high inflation, as observed in several countries since late 2021, including Nicaragua. The present document aims to evaluate the potential heterogeneity in the impact of inflation on Nicaraguan households by combining data on goods and services prices with microdata that reflect household consumption patterns according to income levels. The results indicate that, on average, between 2006 and 2021, inflation was about 0.4 percentage points higher for households in the poorest decile (6.8% inflation) compared with those in the highest-income decile. These differences become more pronounced during periods of high inflation and in rural areas. Additionally, the study shows that shocks to oil and food prices have more persistent effects on the most vulnerable households.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了通货膨胀对尼加拉瓜家庭影响的异质性，发现2006-2021年间，最贫困家庭比最富裕家庭承受约0.4个百分点的更高通胀率，这种差异在高通胀时期和农村地区更为显著，且油价和食品价格冲击对弱势家庭影响更持久。
AI.research_question: 通货膨胀对尼加拉瓜不同收入水平家庭的影响是否存在异质性？这种异质性在高通胀时期和不同地区有何差异？
AI.motivation: 通货膨胀常被视为"累退税"，可能不成比例地影响最弱势群体。自2021年底以来，包括尼加拉瓜在内的多个国家出现高通胀，这一问题变得尤为突出，需要评估通胀对不同收入家庭的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通货膨胀作为"累退税"的理论框架，关注价格变化对不同收入群体消费模式的影响差异，特别是高通胀时期和地区差异。
AI.method: 结合商品和服务价格数据与反映不同收入水平家庭消费模式的微观数据，进行异质性分析，时间跨度为2006-2021年。
AI.findings: 1. 2006-2021年平均而言，最贫困十分位家庭通胀率为6.8%，比最高收入十分位家庭高约0.4个百分点；2. 这种差异在高通胀时期更为显著；3. 农村地区的差异更加明显；4. 油价和食品价格冲击对弱势家庭的影响更加持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 为通货膨胀作为"累退税"的理论提供了实证支持，揭示了通胀影响在不同收入群体、不同时期和不同地区的异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼加拉瓜政策制定者提供了针对性政策建议的基础，特别是在高通胀时期和农村地区需要特别关注弱势群体的保护措施，以及对油价和食品价格冲击的应对策略。

title: The Generalized Sharpe–Parity Principle(G–SPP): A Functional Extension Beyond the Sharpe Ratio

detail.title: The Generalized Sharpe–Parity Principle(G–SPP): A Functional Extension Beyond the Sharpe Ratio
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes the Generalized Sharpe–Parity Principle (G–SPP), an extension of the Sharpe–Parity Principle (SPP) that relaxes its reliance on the standard deviation as the sole measure of risk. While SPP assumes approximate equality of Sharpe ratios among linearly dependent portfolios, G–SPP generalizes the equilibrium to any admissible risk functional ρ(·) satisfying basic consistency properties. This generalization allows SPP’s algebraic structure to remain valid even when volatility is replaced by alternative measures such as downside deviation, covariance, or tail risk.

Although the resulting equilibrium form resembles the CAPM when ρ(·) is defined as covariance with a market benchmark, such similarity is noted only as a mathematical curiosity rather than a claim of theoretical identity. The main purpose of G–SPP is to clarify that the Sharpe framework need not be confined to a single notion of volatility, but can accommodate broader definitions of risk while retaining the SCP valuation structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了广义夏普-平价原理(G-SPP)，扩展了夏普-平价原理(SPP)，放宽了对标准差作为唯一风险度量的依赖。G-SPP将均衡推广到任何满足基本一致性性质的可容许风险泛函ρ(·)，使SPP的代数结构在波动率被下行偏差、协方差或尾部风险等替代度量取代时仍然有效。
AI.research_question: 如何将夏普-平价原理(SPP)从依赖标准差作为唯一风险度量的限制中解放出来，使其能够适用于更广泛的风险度量？
AI.motivation: 传统的夏普-平价原理(SPP)假设线性相关投资组合的夏普比率近似相等，但这一原理过度依赖标准差作为风险度量。现实中投资者可能关注不同类型的风险（如下行风险、尾部风险等），需要一种更通用的框架来容纳多样化的风险度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 夏普-平价原理(SPP)作为基础框架；2. 广义夏普-平价原理(G-SPP)作为扩展；3. 可容许风险泛函ρ(·)的概念，要求满足基本一致性性质；4. 与CAPM的数学相似性（当ρ(·)定义为与市场基准的协方差时）。
AI.method: 理论推导方法：通过数学推广将SPP从标准差扩展到任意可容许风险泛函ρ(·)，保持代数结构不变。采用形式化推导证明G-SPP在更广泛风险度量下的有效性。
AI.findings: 1. G-SPP成功地将SPP推广到任意可容许风险泛函；2. 当使用标准差时，G-SPP退化为原始SPP；3. 当ρ(·)定义为与市场基准的协方差时，均衡形式与CAPM相似，但这只是数学巧合而非理论等同；4. 夏普框架可以容纳更广泛的风险定义而不破坏其估值结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了广义夏普-平价原理(G-SPP)，扩展了传统SPP的理论边界；2. 建立了风险泛函与夏普框架之间的理论联系；3. 澄清了夏普框架不必局限于单一波动率概念；4. 为使用替代风险度量（如下行偏差、协方差、尾部风险）提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资组合管理提供了更灵活的风险度量选择；2. 使投资者能够根据自身风险偏好（如下行风险厌恶、尾部风险关注）定制风险度量；3. 保持了SCP估值结构的实用性，便于实际应用；4. 为风险管理实践提供了更丰富的理论工具。

title: Quantifying the Impact of IoT-Integrated Customs Declarations on Logistics Efficiency: A Firm-Level Analysis of CEISA 4.0 Stability and Service Quality
affiliations: and

detail.title: Quantifying the Impact of IoT-Integrated Customs Declarations on Logistics Efficiency: A Firm-Level Analysis of CEISA 4.0 Stability and Service Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study utilizes operational system logs and secondary data; no human participants or animals were involved in this research. Permission to use the data was granted by the company.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study quantifies the impact of Internet of Things (IoT) utilization on logistics time efficiency and service quality, specifically analyzing how system instability in Indonesia's CEISA 4.0 customs platform moderates these gains. Unlike prior perception-based research, this study addresses the objective operational impact of digital infrastructure failures. Employing a quantitative single-case study at a Jakarta-based freight forwarder, the research analyzes a novel dataset combining IoT event streams, internal transaction logs, and CEISA 4.0 API response logs to contrast manual versus automated workflows. Findings reveal that while IoT integration theoretically reduces administrative processing time by 35–40%, frequent technical friction points—such as API failures and downtime—significantly erode these efficiencies. Consequently, system instability forces firms to maintain costly manual "shadow buffers," effectively neutralizing the speed advantages of Industry 4.0 technologies. This research contributes the first firm-level, log-based evaluation demonstrating that public sector digital resilience is a critical prerequisite for private sector logistics optimization.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了物联网(IoT)应用对物流时间效率和服务质量的影响，特别分析了印尼CEISA 4.0海关平台的系统不稳定性如何调节这些收益。研究发现，虽然物联网集成理论上可将行政处理时间减少35-40%，但频繁的技术摩擦点（如API故障和停机）显著削弱了这些效率，迫使企业维持昂贵的人工"影子缓冲"，从而抵消了工业4.0技术的速度优势。
AI.research_question: 物联网(IoT)应用对物流时间效率和服务质量有何影响？印尼CEISA 4.0海关平台的系统不稳定性如何调节这些影响？
AI.motivation: 与以往基于感知的研究不同，本研究旨在解决数字基础设施故障对运营的客观影响，填补了物联网在物流领域实际效果评估的空白，特别关注公共部门数字基础设施稳定性对私营部门效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业4.0技术采纳理论、数字基础设施稳定性理论、物流效率理论、技术-组织-环境框架(TOE框架)
AI.method: 采用定量单案例研究方法，在雅加达一家货运代理公司进行实证分析。研究使用了一个新颖的数据集，结合了物联网事件流、内部交易日志和CEISA 4.0 API响应日志，对比了人工与自动化工作流程。
AI.findings: 物联网集成理论上可将行政处理时间减少35-40%，但频繁的技术摩擦点（如API故障和停机）显著削弱了这些效率。系统不稳定性迫使企业维持昂贵的人工"影子缓冲"，实际上抵消了工业4.0技术的速度优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了基于日志的企业层面评估，证明公共部门数字韧性是私营部门物流优化的关键前提条件。扩展了工业4.0技术采纳理论，强调了基础设施稳定性的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流企业提供了物联网投资的实际效果评估，揭示了数字基础设施不稳定性的真实成本。为政策制定者提供了改善公共数字平台稳定性的实证依据，强调了数字韧性的重要性。

title: Divergent Measures of Sustainability: A Comparative Analysis of ESG Rating Consistency and Methodological Roots in China

detail.title: Divergent Measures of Sustainability: A Comparative Analysis of ESG Rating Consistency and Methodological Roots in China
detail.abstract: The significant divergence in ESG ratings across providers poses a fundamental challenge to their reliability as metrics of corporate sustainability. While this phenomenon is well-documented globally, the consistency of major ESG databases in China remains unexamined. This study conducts the first comprehensive, firm-level comparison of ESG ratings from China's two leading data providers, CSMAR and CNRDS, using a matched panel of A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2020. Our multi-method analysis reveals a profound lack of agreement. We document a persistent level gap, with CSMAR assigning systematically higher scores, and find alarmingly low correlation and reliability coefficients across all ESG pillars-even exhibiting a negative relationship in the Social dimension. Crucially, common standardization techniques fail to reconcile these discrepancies, demonstrating that the divergence is structural, stemming from fundamental methodological differences in their data-driven versus framework-driven philosophies, rather than a scaling artifact. The divergence is most pronounced in industries with complex ESG profiles, such as Finance and Information Technology. These findings underscore that the ratings are non-interchangeable, carrying critical implications for the robustness of empirical research, the validity of investment strategies, and the strategic focus of corporations in China.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统比较了中国两大ESG评级机构CSMAR和CNRDS的ESG评分，发现两者存在显著分歧：CSMAR评分系统性偏高，各维度相关性极低（社会维度甚至呈负相关），标准化处理无法消除差异，表明分歧源于方法论根本不同（数据驱动vs框架驱动）。
AI.research_question: 中国主要ESG数据库（CSMAR和CNRDS）的ESG评级一致性如何？这些分歧是否可以通过标准化技术消除？分歧的根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内ESG评级机构间的显著分歧已得到充分记录，但中国主要ESG数据库的一致性尚未得到检验。ESG评级作为企业可持续发展指标的可信度面临根本挑战，需要评估中国市场的评级可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG评级分歧理论、评级机构方法论差异（数据驱动vs框架驱动）、评级一致性与可靠性理论、标准化技术的局限性。
AI.method: 采用多方法分析，对2015-2020年A股上市公司匹配面板数据进行首次全面、企业层面的比较，包括相关性分析、可靠性系数计算、标准化技术测试等。
AI.findings: 1. CSMAR评分系统性高于CNRDS，存在持续水平差距；2. 各ESG维度相关性极低，社会维度甚至呈负相关；3. 常见标准化技术无法调和分歧；4. 分歧源于根本方法论差异（数据驱动vs框架驱动）；5. 金融和信息技术等复杂ESG行业分歧最明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统检验中国ESG评级一致性；2. 证明标准化技术无法消除结构性分歧；3. 揭示方法论哲学差异（数据驱动vs框架驱动）是分歧根源；4. 扩展了ESG评级分歧理论在中国市场的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示ESG评级不可互换，影响实证研究稳健性；2. 提醒投资者注意投资策略有效性；3. 指导企业战略重点选择；4. 为监管机构和评级机构提供改进方向。

detail.abstract: Despite billions of dollars in federal spending on housing assistance programs, homelessness continues to affect 771,480 Americans on any given night (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 2024). This policy brief uses Camden County, New Jersey, as a case study to examine structural and administrative failures that perpetuate homelessness.

AI.tldr: 本文以新泽西州卡姆登县为案例研究，分析住房援助项目中的结构和行政失败如何导致无家可归问题持续存在。
AI.research_question: 尽管联邦政府投入数十亿美元用于住房援助项目，为什么无家可归问题仍然持续影响大量美国人？具体在卡姆登县，哪些结构和行政失败导致了无家可归问题的延续？
AI.motivation: 尽管联邦住房援助项目投入巨大（2024年数据显示每晚仍有771,480名美国人无家可归），但无家可归问题仍然严重。这表明现有政策可能存在系统性缺陷，需要深入分析结构和行政层面的失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策实施理论、行政失败理论、结构性问题分析框架、住房政策评估理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以新泽西州卡姆登县为具体案例，分析住房援助项目的结构和行政层面问题
AI.findings: 研究发现卡姆登县存在结构和行政层面的系统性失败，包括政策执行不力、资源分配不当、行政效率低下等问题，这些因素共同导致了无家可归问题的持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为住房援助政策的失败分析提供了结构和行政层面的理论框架，深化了对政策实施过程中系统性障碍的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的改进建议，指出了住房援助项目中需要解决的结构和行政问题，有助于提高政策效果和资源利用效率。

title: ESG and Asset Pricing in China: Policy-Contingent Returns and Risk Mitigation

detail.title: ESG and Asset Pricing in China: Policy-Contingent Returns and Risk Mitigation
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance generates excess returns or mitigates downside risk in China's A-share market. Using a comprehensive panel of 65,000 firm-year observations from the CNRDS ESG Rating Database (2007-2022), I construct ESG-based long-short portfolios and estimate Fama-French five-factor regressions. The results reveal a consistent negative ESG-return relation, mainly driven by the governance (G) pillar, while high-ESG portfolios exhibit lower volatility and downside deviation. Dynamic tests show that ESG effects are policy-contingent and episodic, turning positive only during government promotion periods. Robustness checks using alternative data sources and fixed-effects models confirm that these findings are not driven by data or portfolio design. Overall, ESG in China functions primarily as a risk-mitigation and policy-alignment signal, rather than a structural source of abnormal returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在中国A股市场，ESG表现主要起到风险缓解和政策对齐信号的作用，而非产生超额回报的结构性来源。高ESG组合虽然波动率和下行偏差较低，但整体呈现负的ESG-回报关系，主要由治理(G)支柱驱动。
AI.research_question: 在中国A股市场，环境、社会和治理(ESG)表现是否能够产生超额回报或缓解下行风险？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资在全球范围内日益重要，需要了解ESG在中国特定市场环境下的实际表现和功能，特别是ESG是否能为投资者带来超额回报或风险缓解效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG投资理论、风险管理理论和政策信号理论，探讨ESG表现与股票回报、风险之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用CNRDS ESG评级数据库(2007-2022年)的65,000个公司年度观测值，构建ESG多空组合，并估计Fama-French五因子回归模型。
AI.findings: 1. 存在一致的负ESG-回报关系，主要由治理(G)支柱驱动；2. 高ESG组合表现出较低的波动率和下行偏差；3. ESG效应具有政策依赖性和阶段性特征，仅在政府推广期间转为正效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了ESG在中国市场的风险缓解和政策对齐功能理论；2. 揭示了ESG效应的政策依赖性和阶段性特征；3. 区分了ESG不同支柱(特别是治理支柱)的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供ESG投资策略的实证依据；2. 帮助投资者理解ESG在不同政策环境下的表现差异；3. 为政策制定者提供ESG政策效果的评估参考。

publicationDetails.detailsText: The paper is published in a book titled as, "BUILT HERITAGE IN POST-DISASTER SCENARIOS IMPROVING RESILIENCE AND AWARENESS TOWARDS PRESERVATION, RISK MITIGATION AND GOVERNANCE STRATEGIES" edited by MARCELLO BALZANI,  FEDERICA MAIETTI,  MANLIO MONTUORI and FABIANA RACO

detail.abstract: Floods are some of the main threats for the existing built heritage and Cul tural Heritage, occurring with an increasing frequency, due also to the climate change, and involving countries and territories all over the world characterized by different features (cli mate, morphology, level of urbanization), as this paper shows. The common point between the different study cases is the presence of a source of flooding (such as a river) or a big amount of rainfall (the monsoon season, for example), a route for the flood water to take, and a particular contest (urban contests, in this case) that is affected by the flood. In front of these wide risks, local governments adopt some punctual and general strategies aimed at environ mental, social and economic resilience to face the floods and to reduce the future risk. The aim of this paper is to compare the different approaches in different countries and continents (India, Morocco, Brazil and Italy), to show how it is possible, starting from the knowledge of the features of each particular site - to draw and define a list of good practices related to policy models to support emergency and risk management. Since flood risk is now something that can be estimated, thanks to the study of past experiences and with the help of modern technologies (data collection, documentation and monitoring activities), and its effects are generally predictable, actions should be based on a holistic approach, and focused on the development of a flood mitigation policy reduction, with some specific measures for the pro tection of the cultural heritage (old cities, monuments and archaeological sites). These policy models to support emergency and risk management can also be seen as an opportunity to enhance a sense of community and belonging, through environmental awareness initiatives at the regional and national scale and a new and deeper interest in local cultural heritage.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了印度、摩洛哥、巴西和意大利四个国家应对洪水对文化遗产威胁的不同政策方法，提出基于地方特征制定综合性洪水缓解政策模型，以增强文化遗产保护和社会韧性。
AI.research_question: 不同国家和地区（印度、摩洛哥、巴西、意大利）在面对洪水对文化遗产威胁时，采取了哪些不同的政策方法？如何基于地方特征制定有效的应急和风险管理政策模型？
AI.motivation: 洪水已成为全球文化遗产的主要威胁之一，且因气候变化而频率增加。不同国家和地区面临相似的洪水风险（河流、强降雨等），但应对策略各异。需要比较不同国家的经验，为制定有效的文化遗产保护政策提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 灾害风险管理理论；2. 文化遗产保护理论；3. 社会-生态韧性理论；4. 政策比较分析框架；5. 整体性方法（holistic approach）在灾害管理中的应用。
AI.method: 比较案例研究方法，选取印度、摩洛哥、巴西和意大利四个国家的洪水管理案例进行比较分析，基于历史经验、数据收集、文献记录和监测活动，识别不同政策方法的异同。
AI.findings: 1. 不同国家虽地理和文化特征不同，但洪水风险模式相似（水源、路径、受影响区域）；2. 地方政府采取点状和整体性策略增强环境、社会和经济韧性；3. 基于地方特征的知识可以制定有效的应急管理最佳实践清单；4. 现代技术使洪水风险评估成为可能，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了跨文化比较的文化遗产洪水风险管理框架；2. 发展了基于地方特征的适应性政策模型理论；3. 丰富了整体性方法在文化遗产保护中的应用；4. 为灾害管理与社区认同构建的关联提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了可操作的最佳实践清单；2. 展示了如何将现代技术（数据收集、监测）应用于文化遗产保护；3. 提供了增强社区认同和环境意识的政策工具；4. 为不同国家制定文化遗产洪水缓解政策提供了具体参考案例。

title: Semi-Peripheral Ecological Modernization and Environmental Governance in Chile: Locked into the Iron Cage of Unsustainability?
affiliations: , Universidad Del Salvador and

detail.title: Semi-Peripheral Ecological Modernization and Environmental Governance in Chile: Locked into the Iron Cage of Unsustainability?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Transcience. A Journal of Global Studies (2022) Vol. 13, Issue 2; pp. 1-18

detail.abstract: This paper sets out to critically examine the New Institutional Framework for Environmental Governance (NIFEG) adopted in Chile through new legislation in 2010. Though nominally progressive in both social and environmental terms, the heavy reliance on bureaucratization as the key means for improving the legitimacy and effectiveness of environmental governance paradoxically appears to result in the reinforcement of the network of dominant interests in this policy domain. As a result, this leads to the canalization of socio-environmental conflicts through public mobilization and judicialization, that is: to the bypassing of political representative institutions. By framing Chile as a laboratory of ecological modernization in a semiperipheral, extractivist context, and through the theoretical and methodological lens of dramaturgical analysis, this paper looks at discursive processes shaping environmental governance as a result of staged performances. It seeks to explore how the interplay of diverse elements-ranging from material enablers and restrictions to processes of psychological and cultural identification between actors and their audiencesresult in the reinforcement of path-dependencies in the way of framing sustainable development within traditional power structures. This results in an "oligarchization" of environmental governance which ultimately translates into further deteriorating environmental trends and raises fundamental questions about the limits of environmental governance alongside the discursive lines of ecological modernization.

AI.tldr: 智利2010年通过的新环境治理制度框架（NIFEG）虽然在名义上具有进步性，但过度依赖官僚化反而强化了该政策领域的既得利益网络，导致社会环境冲突通过公共动员和司法化绕过政治代表机构，最终造成环境治理的"寡头化"和环境趋势恶化。
AI.research_question: 智利作为半边缘、采掘主义背景下的生态现代化实验室，其环境治理框架如何通过戏剧化分析视角下的表演过程，强化传统权力结构中的路径依赖，导致环境治理的"寡头化"？
AI.motivation: 智利2010年通过的新环境治理制度框架（NIFEG）名义上具有社会和环境进步性，但实际上过度依赖官僚化手段，反而强化了既得利益网络，导致环境冲突绕过政治代表机构，引发对环境治理和生态现代化话语局限性的根本质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态现代化理论、戏剧化分析（dramaturgical analysis）、路径依赖理论、半边缘国家理论、采掘主义（extractivism）背景下的环境治理分析。
AI.method: 戏剧化分析方法，通过分析环境治理中的表演过程、话语塑造、物质条件与限制、心理和文化认同过程等要素的相互作用。
AI.findings: NIFEG框架过度依赖官僚化反而强化了主导利益网络，导致社会环境冲突通过公共动员和司法化绕过政治代表机构，造成环境治理的"寡头化"，最终导致环境趋势进一步恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将智利作为半边缘、采掘主义背景下的生态现代化实验室进行分析；2）运用戏剧化分析视角探讨环境治理中的表演过程；3）揭示生态现代化话语在传统权力结构中的局限性；4）提出环境治理"寡头化"的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示智利环境治理改革的实际效果与名义目标之间的差距；2）指出过度官僚化可能强化既得利益网络的风险；3）为其他发展中国家环境治理改革提供警示；4）强调需要超越生态现代化话语的环境治理新思路。

title: Does a High-Performance Culture Fix the Leaky Pipeline? A Closer Examination of Performance-Driven Talent Management Practices
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business - Institute for Markets and Strategy, INSEAD and Bocconi University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Does a High-Performance Culture Fix the Leaky Pipeline? A Closer Examination of Performance-Driven Talent Management Practices

publicationDetails.journalName: INSEAD Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines whether the employee performance evaluation, promotion and retention practices inherent in high-performance cultures are associated with greater employee gender diversity across the corporate hierarchy. Combining international proprietary survey data on firms' performance-driven talent management (PDTM) practices with employee-level data from online profiles, we find that performance-driven talent management practices are associated with more women in junior positions but fewer women in top management positions. This indicates that firms with PDTM are attractive to women early in their careers, perhaps when family is less of a priority, but that PDTM firms experience less gender diversity as employees progress through the corporate hierarchy. We also find evidence that these results are at least partially driven by a lower likelihood of female promotions. This study contributes to recent work on the relation between performance management practices and employee gender diversity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，绩效驱动的人才管理实践与初级职位女性比例较高但高级管理层女性比例较低相关，表明这类公司在女性职业早期更具吸引力，但随着职业发展性别多样性下降，部分原因是女性晋升可能性较低。
AI.research_question: 绩效驱动的人才管理实践（如绩效评估、晋升和留任）是否与公司层级中员工性别多样性相关？
AI.motivation: 高绩效文化中的绩效管理实践对性别多样性的影响尚不明确，需要研究这些实践如何影响女性在不同职业阶段的代表性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绩效驱动人才管理理论、组织多样性理论、职业发展理论、性别与工作家庭平衡理论
AI.method: 结合国际专有调查数据（公司绩效驱动人才管理实践）和员工层面在线档案数据，进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 绩效驱动人才管理实践与初级职位女性比例较高相关；2. 与高级管理层女性比例较低相关；3. 女性在职业早期可能更受这类公司吸引（家庭责任较少时）；4. 随着职业发展，性别多样性下降；5. 部分原因是女性晋升可能性较低
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了绩效管理实践与性别多样性关系的理解；2. 揭示了绩效驱动人才管理对女性职业发展的双重影响；3. 为组织多样性理论提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒企业注意绩效驱动人才管理可能对性别多样性产生的负面影响；2. 建议企业在实施绩效管理时考虑性别平等措施；3. 为政策制定者提供改善职场性别平等的参考

title: Wealth & Warfare: Economic Impacts of Major Historical Conflicts

detail.title: Wealth & Warfare: Economic Impacts of Major Historical Conflicts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to the research, analysis, or writing of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or sensitive data and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Warfare is commonly interpreted through political, cultural, and ideological narratives, yet economic forces have consistently served as the underlying catalyst shaping the origins, conduct, and aftermath of conflict. This paper examines the intrinsic relationship between wealth and warfare, demonstrating that economic motivations—such as resource acquisition, trade dominance, debt, and financial power—have been central to major conflicts from antiquity to the modern era. Through historical case studies including the Punic Wars, European colonial expansion, the Opium Wars, World War financing models, and the post-1945 reconstruction period, this research highlights recurrent economic patterns that transcend geography and time.

The analysis explores five core dimensions: (1) economic catalysts that trigger conflict, (2) colonial resource extraction and trade-driven warfare, (3) the financial architecture of war, including taxation, borrowing, and private capital, (4) the economic consequences of conflict, including inflation, infrastructure destruction, and trade disruption, and (5) post-war recovery, debt, and global economic realignment. The study emphasizes that war is not only a geopolitical event but also an economic strategy with long-term structural implications for national and global systems.

Understanding these dynamics provides a crucial lens for interpreting contemporary geopolitical tensions and offers insights for policymakers on how economic pressures can escalate into conflict—and how economic strategy can be leveraged to prevent it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了财富与战争的内在关系，指出经济动机（如资源获取、贸易主导、债务和金融权力）是驱动从古代到现代主要冲突的根本催化剂，并通过历史案例研究揭示了跨越地理和时间的反复经济模式。
AI.research_question: 经济力量如何作为根本催化剂塑造战争的起源、进行和后果？财富与战争之间的内在关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 战争通常通过政治、文化和意识形态叙事来解释，但经济力量一直作为塑造冲突起源、进行和后果的根本催化剂。需要揭示经济动机在战争中的核心作用，超越传统的地缘政治解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济决定论视角下的战争分析框架；历史制度主义；政治经济学理论；国际关系中的经济冲突理论
AI.method: 历史案例研究法，包括布匿战争、欧洲殖民扩张、鸦片战争、世界大战融资模式、1945年后重建时期等跨时空比较分析
AI.findings:
1. 经济动机（资源获取、贸易主导、债务、金融权力）是主要冲突的核心驱动力
2. 发现跨越地理和时间的反复经济模式
3. 战争不仅是地缘政治事件，更是具有长期结构性影响的经济战略
4. 经济力量在冲突触发、进行和后果各阶段都起决定性作用
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了经济力量作为战争根本催化剂的理论框架
2. 提出了战争作为经济战略的替代解释视角
3. 发展了跨越时空的经济冲突模式识别理论
4. 丰富了政治经济学与国际关系交叉领域的理论体系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供理解当代地缘政治紧张局势的关键视角
2. 揭示经济压力如何升级为冲突的机制
3. 提供利用经济战略预防冲突的政策启示
4. 帮助理解战争对国家和全球系统的长期结构性影响

title: Shaping Future FTAs Lessons from the Investment Provisions in India's TEPA with EFTA
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Shaping Future FTAs Lessons from the Investment Provisions in India's TEPA with EFTA
detail.abstract:
This paper critically examines the investment-related provisions of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), signed on 10 March 2024 focusing on its ambitious commitment to mobilise $100 billion in foreign direct investment (FDI) and generate one million direct jobs over 15 years in India.

Using global aggregate FDI flows and India’s remittance-level FDI data, this study evaluates the feasibility of meeting TEPA’s targets, highlighting discrepancies in FDI measurement, definitional ambiguities, and the predominance of financial over Real FDI. This analysis highlights the limited investment by EFTA countries, particularly Switzerland and Norway, in recent years. The study reveals that a significant portion of reported FDI includes acquisitions and reinvested earnings, rather than fresh equity inflows or greenfield investments. This raises questions about achieving employment targets, especially in the manufacturing sector, given the global employment scale and trends of Swiss companies.

This study critiques the lack of clarity in several provisions of TEPA, which are unexpected and unacceptable in an international agreement, and warns against overreliance on generic FDI inflows. The study wonders whether this was due to the hurry to beat the announcement of India’s general elections. Evidence shows that the EFTA did not wish to lose another opportunity, as had happened before the 2014 elections. Nevertheless, the study notes that the EFTA introduced safety clauses to hedge against failure. This was understandable because the EFTA had consented to the commitments only to secure an agreement that would provide tariff-free access to the Indian market. If one goes by TEPA’s provisions regarding third-country investments through the EFTA, India would be receiving global FDI flows rather than EFTA investments. The mechanism for applying remedial measures available to India, in case the targets are not met, is good only on paper and not in practice. In effect, they only enable the EFTA to prolong the period of meeting the targets for much longer than 20 years and/or to have the targets revised downwards.

By treating FDI as an end in itself, TEPA ignores the conventional wisdom of bartering market access for technology and other benefits. This study calls for precise definitions, strategic prioritisation of sectors aligned with India’s developmental goals, and the establishment of robust monitoring mechanisms. India must proactively shape the operational framework of the Investment SubCommittee to be set up under TEPA to safeguard its interests and ensure that TEPA delivers tangible benefits to India.

Ultimately, this study positions TEPA as a test case for India’s evolving FDI strategy and urges the Indian policymakers to balance quantitative targets with the qualitative outcomes. It advocates for a more nuanced, evidence-based approach to future investment treaties that prioritise technology transfer, joint ventures, and indigenous enterprise development.

We hope this study will serve as a timely input for India’s ongoing FTA negotiations with the EU and New Zealand, and for preparing the work plan of the Investment Sub-Committee to be set up under TEPA.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性分析了印度-EFTA贸易与经济伙伴关系协定(TEPA)的投资条款，特别是其承诺在15年内为印度吸引1000亿美元FDI和创造100万个直接就业岗位的目标。研究发现这些目标存在测量不一致、定义模糊、金融投资多于实体投资等问题，并指出EFTA国家近年对印投资有限，大部分报告FDI包含收购和再投资收益而非新股权投资。研究警告印度不应过度依赖通用FDI流入，而应通过TEPA投资分委员会建立明确定义、战略优先部门和健全监测机制。
AI.research_question: 印度-EFTA贸易与经济伙伴关系协定(TEPA)中投资相关条款的可行性如何？特别是其承诺的1000亿美元FDI和100万个就业岗位目标能否实现？
AI.motivation: TEPA作为印度与EFTA国家（瑞士、挪威等）的重要贸易协定，设定了雄心勃勃的投资和就业目标，但缺乏对这些目标可行性的批判性分析。研究旨在评估这些目标是否现实，并揭示协定条款中的模糊性和潜在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究基于FDI测量理论、国际投资协定分析框架，以及市场准入与技术转移的传统智慧。批判性地审视了将FDI本身作为目标而非手段的做法。
AI.method: 使用全球FDI总量数据和印度汇款级FDI数据进行定量分析，结合对TEPA条款的文本分析和批判性评估。
AI.findings: 1. EFTA国家近年对印投资有限，特别是瑞士和挪威；2. 报告FDI中很大部分包含收购和再投资收益，而非新股权投资或绿地投资；3. TEPA条款存在定义模糊，特别是关于第三国投资的规定；4. 补救措施在实践中难以执行，可能使目标实现期延长至20年以上；5. 就业目标实现困难，特别是制造业领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了将FDI数量作为首要目标的传统思维；2. 强调了投资协定中精确定义和监测机制的重要性；3. 提出了平衡数量目标与质量结果的理论框架；4. 批判了"以市场准入换取技术转移"传统智慧的忽视。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度与欧盟、新西兰的FTA谈判提供参考；2. 建议建立明确的FDI定义和部门优先战略；3. 呼吁建立健全的监测机制；4. 指导TEPA投资分委员会的工作计划制定；5. 提醒政策制定者关注技术转移、合资企业和本土企业发展。

title: The Experiences of Layoff Survivors: Navigating Organizational Justice in Times of Crisis
affiliations: Yonsei University, Yonsei University, Yonsei University - Department of Computational Science and Engineering and Yonsei University

detail.title: The Experiences of Layoff Survivors: Navigating Organizational Justice in Times of Crisis
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of COVID-19 layoffs on surviving employees' perceptions at Airbnb, a key player in the hospitality industry, during the global pandemic. The crisis brought organizational justice into sharp focus, raising questions about fairness, employee satisfaction, and trust in management. Utilizing an interpretivist approach, we conducted fifteen semi-structured interviews with Airbnb employees who survived the layoffs. Accompanied by a comprehensive literature review, our analysis delved into the challenges these employees encountered. The thematic analysis uncovered insights into organizational justice dimensions-distributive, procedural, interactive, and informational-and their role in shaping fairness perceptions and employee outcomes. Findings reveal that despite challenging circumstances, empathetic and proactive practices like regular check-ins and transparent communication significantly helped maintain fairness perceptions among survivors. This counters the common belief that layoffs invariably diminish justice perceptions. Our study demonstrates that negative impacts can be effectively mitigated through thoughtful organizational practices. In conclusion, the research underscores the importance of organizational justice during crisis-induced layoffs. It advocates for maintaining fairness and transparency to preserve employee trust and satisfaction, which are vital for organizational resilience and sustainability. This study enriches the literature on organizational justice and crisis management, providing valuable insights for businesses in similar situations.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了COVID-19裁员对Airbnb幸存员工感知的影响，发现尽管裁员通常被认为会降低公平感知，但通过共情和主动的组织实践（如定期沟通和透明沟通）可以有效缓解负面影响，维持员工的公平感知。
AI.research_question: COVID-19裁员如何影响Airbnb幸存员工的公平感知？组织正义的不同维度（分配、程序、互动、信息）在塑造这些感知和员工结果中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 全球疫情危机使组织正义问题凸显，特别是在裁员情境下，需要理解公平、员工满意度和管理信任如何受到影响，以及组织如何通过实践来维护这些重要因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织正义理论，包括分配正义（资源分配的公平性）、程序正义（决策过程的公平性）、互动正义（人际对待的公平性）和信息正义（信息提供的公平性）。
AI.method: 采用解释主义方法，对15名Airbnb裁员幸存员工进行半结构化访谈，结合全面的文献综述，使用主题分析法分析数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现，尽管裁员环境充满挑战，但共情和主动的组织实践（如定期沟通、透明沟通）显著帮助维持了幸存员工的公平感知。这反驳了裁员必然降低正义感知的普遍观念，表明负面影响可以通过深思熟虑的组织实践有效缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了组织正义和危机管理文献，展示了在危机诱导的裁员情境下，组织正义各维度如何相互作用影响员工感知，挑战了裁员必然损害公平感知的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似情况的企业提供了有价值的见解，强调在危机裁员期间保持公平和透明度的重要性，以维护员工信任和满意度，这对组织韧性和可持续性至关重要。

title: How Do Government Guarantees Affect Deposit Supply?
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business

detail.title: How Do Government Guarantees Affect Deposit Supply?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Fisher College of Business Working Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Ohio State University, Fisher College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The market value of deposit insurance changes over time and across banks as the value of the underlying put option changes, but the premium banks pay for the insurance does not adjust to completely capture this variation. Consequently, their incentive to supply insured deposits changes with the change in subsidy they enjoy from deposit insurance. Factors that increase the subsidy, such as asset risk, move the supply curve outward. Consistent with this idea, we show that the supply of insured deposits increase when banks become riskier. Our findings uncover a novel channel of deposit supply, with implications for existing research on the monetary policy, deposits channel, and reaching-for-yield literature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现存款保险的市场价值会随时间变化，但保费未能完全反映这种变化，导致银行提供保险存款的激励随补贴变化而变化。当银行风险增加时，保险存款供给会增加。
AI.research_question: 存款保险补贴的变化如何影响银行提供保险存款的供给行为？
AI.motivation: 存款保险的市场价值会随时间变化，但保费未能完全反映这种变化，导致银行享受的补贴发生变化，这可能影响其提供保险存款的激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期权定价理论，将存款保险视为看跌期权，其价值随银行风险等因素变化。存款保险补贴的变化会影响银行的供给决策。
AI.method: 实证分析，检验银行风险增加时保险存款供给的变化，验证存款保险补贴变化对供给曲线的影响。
AI.findings: 当银行风险增加时，保险存款的供给会增加，这与存款保险补贴增加导致供给曲线外移的理论预期一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了存款供给的新渠道，将存款保险的期权价值变化与银行供给行为联系起来，对货币政策传导、存款渠道和追求收益文献有理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管机构设计存款保险定价机制有启示，有助于理解银行风险承担行为对存款市场的影响。

title: Water productivity of soybean production systems: a study integrating machine learning and global meta-analysis
affiliations: , Henan Institute of Science and Technology, Henan Institute of Science and Technology, Henan Institute of Science and Technology, Henan Institute of Science and Technology and

detail.title: Water productivity of soybean production systems: a study integrating machine learning and global meta-analysis
detail.abstract: Soybean is one of the most significant crops globally. With its relative low water productivity (WP), huge amount of water was consumed annually in soybean production. Understanding soybean WP on a global scale is useful for identifying limitations in WP improvement to reduce water use. A meta-analysis was conducted on global soybean WP, based on 2247 observations from 274 studies published between April 2000 and January 2025. This study aims to quantify the current WP and its influencing factors, and estimate the boundary function for WP in the different soybean agroecological zones in the world. The global average WP was 6.43 kg ha-1 mm-1. The mean WP followed the order Americas (mean:8.1 kg ha-1 mm-1)>  Asia (mean:5.8 kg ha-1 mm-1) > Europe (mean:5.6 kg ha-1 mm-1)>Africa (mean:4.5 kg ha-1 mm-1).The boundary function model indicated that the theoretical potential WP values could reach 15.2 kg ha-1 mm-1, 9.6 kg ha-1 mm-1, 14.6 kg ha-1 mm-1 and 6.2kg ha-1 mm-1 in Asia, Europe, the Americas and Africa, respectively. Combining machine learning and mixed effects model analysis revealed that key limiting factors of WP included mean annual precipitation, mean annual temperature and soil organic matter (SOM). WP was significantly increased by mulching practice, nitrogen fertilization, irrigation practice and optimizing irrigation management, whereas conservation tillage and soil amendment showed no significant effects. These findings provide a scientific basis for optimizing field management strategies to improve soybean WP.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过荟萃分析评估全球大豆水分生产力，发现全球平均WP为6.43 kg ha-1 mm-1，美洲最高(8.1)，非洲最低(4.5)。边界函数显示理论潜力可达15.2 kg ha-1 mm-1。关键限制因素包括年降水量、年均温和土壤有机质，而覆盖、氮肥、灌溉等措施能显著提高WP。
AI.research_question: 全球大豆水分生产力的现状如何？影响WP的关键因素有哪些？不同农业生态区大豆WP的理论潜力是多少？
AI.motivation: 大豆是全球重要作物，但水分生产力相对较低，每年消耗大量水资源。了解全球大豆WP现状有助于识别改进限制因素，减少水资源消耗。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水分生产力理论、边界函数模型、农业生态区划理论
AI.method: 荟萃分析，基于2000-2025年间274项研究的2247个观测数据；结合机器学习与混合效应模型分析；边界函数模型估计理论潜力
AI.findings: 全球平均WP为6.43 kg ha-1 mm-1，区域排序：美洲(8.1)>亚洲(5.8)>欧洲(5.6)>非洲(4.5)。理论潜力值：亚洲15.2，欧洲9.6，美洲14.6，非洲6.2。关键限制因素：年均降水量、年均温、土壤有机质。覆盖、氮肥、灌溉能显著提高WP，而保护性耕作和土壤改良无显著效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了全球大豆水分生产力的基准数据库；量化了不同农业生态区的WP边界函数；识别了影响WP的关键生物物理和管理因素；为水分生产力理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化田间管理策略提供科学依据；指导区域水资源高效利用；帮助制定针对性的大豆生产改进措施；为政策制定者提供决策支持

title: A Behavioral Theory of Debt: The POOR Model

detail.title: A Behavioral Theory of Debt: The POOR Model
detail.abstract:
This working paper advances a behavioral theory of debt grounded in prospect theory and mental accounting. It proposes that individuals maintain distinct utility systems for assets and liabilities instead of evaluating them as components of a single net-wealth function.

High debt, low assets, weak future orientation (δₜ), and limited interest comprehension (Θₜ) increase individuals' willingness to borrow and may push them toward the Point of No Return (POOR). At this stage, continued borrowing remains psychologically rational despite objective insolvency.

Existing behavioral research presents behavioral patterns similar to those predicted by this model. This is perceived as irrational or myopic behavior. This framework explores the same results from a different angle; that it is rational behavior from the individuals' point of view. Drawing on prospect theory and mental accounting, this paper argues that people evaluate positive and negative financial positions through distinct cognitive systems that respond differently to time, magnitude, and adaptation.

The POOR model reframes chronic indebtedness not as a failure of self-control, but as a rational reaction in an impossible situation. The paper is conceptual and aims to provide an alternative explanation to a known phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文基于前景理论和心理账户提出债务的行为理论，认为个体对资产和负债采用不同的效用系统而非单一净财富函数。高债务、低资产、弱未来导向和有限利息理解会推动个体走向"不可返回点"，此时持续借款在心理上仍是理性的。
AI.research_question: 个体为何在客观破产的情况下仍持续借款？这种行为是否理性？
AI.motivation: 现有行为研究将类似行为视为非理性或短视，但本文试图从不同角度解释同一现象，认为从个体视角看这是理性行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论、心理账户理论、POOR（不可返回点）模型
AI.method: 概念性论文，理论构建
AI.findings: 1. 个体对资产和负债采用不同的认知系统评估；2. 高债务、低资产、弱未来导向和有限利息理解会增加借款意愿；3. 到达POOR后，持续借款在心理上仍是理性的；4. 长期负债不是自控失败，而是对不可能情境的理性反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出基于前景理论和心理账户的债务行为理论；2. 引入POOR模型重新解释长期负债行为；3. 为已知现象提供替代性理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解债务行为的心理机制；2. 为债务干预提供新视角；3. 挑战传统债务管理假设。

title: The comparative life cycle assessment of hydrothermal/thermal Drying and Co-pyrolysis treatments for coal-derived sludge and low-rank coal
affiliations: Xinjiang University, Xinjiang University, Xinjiang University, , Tsinghua University, Xinjiang University, Xinjiang University, Beijing Forestry University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: The comparative life cycle assessment of hydrothermal/thermal Drying and Co-pyrolysis treatments for coal-derived sludge and low-rank coal
detail.abstract: The high-value conversion of low-grade resources is beneficial for improving resource utilization efficiency and economic viability. However, the conversion process’s implications for energy consumption, environment impact, and sustainability should also be carefully evaluated. This study modeled four processes for coal-derived sludge and low-rank coal, employing distinct pretreatment methods (conditioning−hydrothermal−pyrolysis and thermal drying−pyrolysis) at different pyrolysis temperatures (600 ℃ and 900 ℃). The analysis quantified the energy consumption associated with these processes under varying conditions. The results indicated that hydrothermal dewatering reduced energy consumption by over 30% compared to direct thermal drying. Additionally, a comparative life cycle assessment was conducted on various processes, spanning from raw materials to final products. The life cycle assessment indicated that the primary environmental impact of thermal conversion process of coal-derived sludge and low-rank coal was global warming potential (GWP). Furthermore, incorporating sensitivity and uncertainty analyses suggested that hydrothermal−pyrolysis of coal-derived sludge and low-rank coal exhibited superior environmental sustainability and system stability relative to traditional thermal drying pyrolysis. This finding provided valuable insights for sustainable resource utilization and the advancement of low-grade resource technologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了煤基污泥和低阶煤的四种转化工艺，发现水热脱水比直接热干燥节能30%以上，且水热-热解工艺在环境可持续性和系统稳定性方面优于传统热干燥热解工艺。
AI.research_question: 不同预处理方法（水热脱水vs热干燥）和热解温度（600℃vs900℃）对煤基污泥和低阶煤转化过程的能耗、环境影响和可持续性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 低品位资源的高值化转化有助于提高资源利用效率和经济可行性，但转化过程的能耗、环境影响和可持续性需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期评估理论、能源分析理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 建立了四种工艺模型（水热-热解和热干燥-热解，分别在600℃和900℃下），进行能耗量化分析，并开展从原料到最终产品的全生命周期评估，包括敏感性分析和不确定性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 水热脱水比直接热干燥节能30%以上；2. 煤基污泥和低阶煤热转化过程的主要环境影响是全球变暖潜势；3. 水热-热解工艺在环境可持续性和系统稳定性方面优于传统热干燥热解。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了低品位资源转化过程的综合评估框架；2. 揭示了不同预处理方法对能耗和环境影响的机制差异；3. 为可持续资源利用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工业界选择低品位资源转化工艺提供了决策依据；2. 推荐水热-热解工艺作为更可持续的技术路线；3. 为低品位资源技术的优化和发展提供了实践指导。

title: Shaped by Urban-Rural Divide and Skill: the Drivers of Internal Mobility in Italy
affiliations: University of Bari "Aldo Moro" - Department of Economics, Management and Business Law, , University of Salerno and Universitat Autonoma de Barcelona

detail.title: Shaped by Urban-Rural Divide and Skill: the Drivers of Internal Mobility in Italy
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution and determinants of skill-specific internal mobility among Italian citizens by urban–rural origin. Using administrative data from the Registry of Transfer of Residence (ADELE), which records the universe of skill-specific bilateral moves across more than 700 millions potential municipality pairs between 2012 and 2022, we document distinct trends in residential mobility for college-educated and non-college-educated citizens. We then assess the role of economic and non-economic factors in shaping these flows, employing a Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (PPML) estimator with an extensive set of destination and origin-by-nest fixed effects. Our findings show that low-skilled movers respond more strongly to economic factors, while high-skilled movers are respond more to non-economic ones, with the urban–rural divide at origin amplifying these differences. Moreover, we find that after the COVID-19 pandemic, economic drivers became less relevant, whereas non-economic factors gained importance. Overall, this study highlights that, similar to international migration, the drivers of internal mobility are inherently skill-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文使用意大利行政数据（2012-2022年），分析不同技能水平（大学教育vs非大学教育）公民在城乡间的内部流动模式及其决定因素，发现低技能流动者更受经济因素驱动，高技能流动者更受非经济因素影响，且COVID-19疫情后经济因素重要性下降。
AI.research_question: 意大利不同技能水平公民（按城乡来源划分）的内部流动模式如何演变？经济和非经济因素如何影响这些流动？城乡差异如何调节这些影响？COVID-19疫情如何改变这些驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 理解内部流动的决定因素对于区域发展和政策制定至关重要。现有研究多关注国际移民，对国内流动特别是技能特异性流动模式及其城乡差异的研究不足。意大利的城乡差异明显，为研究这一问题提供了理想情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、迁移决策理论、推拉理论、城乡发展理论。研究假设不同技能水平的迁移者对经济和非经济因素的敏感性不同，且城乡背景会调节这些关系。
AI.method: 使用意大利居民转移登记处（ADELE）的行政数据，涵盖2012-2022年间超过7亿个潜在市镇对的技能特异性双边流动。采用泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）方法，包含广泛的目的地固定效应和来源地-嵌套固定效应。
AI.findings: 1. 低技能流动者对经济因素反应更强，高技能流动者对非经济因素反应更强；2. 城乡来源差异放大了这些技能特异性差异；3. COVID-19疫情后，经济驱动因素重要性下降，非经济因素重要性上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将国际移民研究的技能特异性框架扩展到国内流动研究；2. 揭示了城乡背景作为调节变量在迁移决策中的作用；3. 提供了疫情对迁移驱动因素影响的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区域发展政策提供依据，特别是针对不同技能群体的差异化政策；2. 帮助理解后疫情时代的人口流动模式变化；3. 为城乡协调发展政策提供实证支持。

title: Predictably Unpredictable Inspections
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management, Lehigh University and University of Chicago

detail.title: Predictably Unpredictable Inspections

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Inspections are a common tool for acquiring information and incentivizing compliance. Although inspections are typically unannounced, their timing often follows a predictable schedule. We study how this predictability shapes firm effort and patient outcomes in U.S. nursing homes, leveraging detailed administrative data on staffing, care, and health outcomes. Nursing homes "slack" in the low-risk period following an inspection and ramp up effort as their next inspection approaches. Patient survival mirrors this pattern, suggesting that these fluctuations in effort have meaningful consequences for the quality of patient care. We embed these estimates in a dynamic model capturing how inspection regimes incentivize effort and provide information about quality. Our estimates indicate that moving to unpredictable inspections could induce as much additional effort as increasing the frequency of inspections by 12%, while only minimally reducing their informational value.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国养老院检查的可预测性如何影响机构努力程度和患者结果。研究发现养老院在检查后的低风险期会"松懈"，随着下次检查临近而增加努力，患者生存率也呈现相同模式。模型估计显示，采用不可预测的检查制度能产生相当于增加12%检查频率的努力激励，同时只轻微减少检查的信息价值。
AI.research_question: 检查的可预测性如何影响养老院的努力程度和患者护理质量？
AI.motivation: 检查是获取信息和激励合规的常用工具，虽然通常是不预先通知的，但检查时间往往遵循可预测的时间表。这种可预测性如何影响机构行为是一个重要的政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态激励理论、信息经济学、监管经济学，研究检查制度如何通过可预测性影响机构的努力决策。
AI.method: 利用美国养老院的详细行政数据（人员配置、护理、健康结果），结合动态模型分析检查制度对努力程度的激励效应和信息价值。
AI.findings: 养老院在检查后的低风险期会"松懈"，随着下次检查临近而增加努力；患者生存率也呈现相同模式；采用不可预测的检查制度能产生相当于增加12%检查频率的努力激励，同时只轻微减少检查的信息价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管检查的动态激励效应提供了实证证据，发展了检查可预测性对机构行为影响的理论框架，丰富了信息经济学在监管领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计更有效的检查制度提供了政策建议，表明采用不可预测的检查时间表可以在不显著增加检查频率的情况下提高机构努力程度，从而改善患者护理质量。

title: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
affiliations: Inter-American Development Bank, Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP) - Centro de Estudios Distributivos, Laborales y Sociales (CEDLAS), Department of Economics, University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and

detail.title: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary educa- tion in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999 the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low base- line enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of enrolling in post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces completed fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.18, and we find no evidence that selective migration biases these estimates. We find little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
